release_notes: The installer now installs PHP's bcmath extension, which the IP2Location and IP2Proxy readers require. Without it Composer rejected the whole lock file and, because install.sh ran under set -e, the script aborted before handing the directory over to www-data - leaving a root-owned tree and blocking every later update from the admin panel. The ownership handover now runs from an EXIT trap so it happens even when an earlier step fails, and the Composer and frontend build steps are no longer fatal. Admin-panel updates retry the dependency install without the bcmath platform check and report the exact command that installs the extension instead of failing with a wall of php.ini paths.
